events.name: Bash
events.input: git status --short | head; ls -a; ls .github/workflows 2><path>; find . -name '*.sh' -not -path './.git/*' | head -50

events.name: Bash
events.input: cat .github/workflows/drift.yml; echo ------; cat -A scripts/check-drift.sh | head -0; cat scripts/check-drift.sh; ls deploy templates; cat README.md | head -30
